## Summary

Update the README before merge: after this change it still documents the old 30-second default, so anyone reading it gets the wrong timeout.

## Changes
The pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.
